verdict.rationale: An agent framework that connects agents to external tools and services could plausibly offer a white-labelable OAuth authorization flow, so this axis applies to Mastra. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions OAuth, authorization flows, custom branding, or bringing your own OAuth app credentials. The docs cover agents, workflows, memory, MCP, deployment and observability, but not this capability.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can white-label the authorization flow with my own branding and my own OAuth app credentials
